sentences.text:
Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 to issue a Writ of
 Mandamus, directing the 1st respondent herein to pass an arbitratio
 award on petitioner's appeal / claim petition dated 30.07.2024 file
 under section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, by appointi
 competent officials for assessing the value of trees and petitioner
 admeasuring an extent of 416 sq.mtr in survey No.209/1g1 and an
 extent of 402 sq.mtrs in survey No.208/3b situated in Mathigiri vil
 Hosur Taluk, Krishnagiri District, enhance and pay appropriate
 compensation to petitioner by reconsidering the award dated
 September, 2023 having Ref. No.Na.Ka. 1318/2023/E1 passed by the
 2nd respondent, in accordance with the procedure contemplated under
Section 26-30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in
 Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Centra
 Act 30 of 2013) and re-fix the compensation as per the Central Act 
 of 2013 within a time frame to be stipulated by this Court and also
 following the procedures contemplated under Section 18-27 of the
 Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
 2/6
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

 
 For Petitioner : Mr. R.Bharath Kumar

1 to 3 Additional Government P
Mujibullahkhan vs The Arbitrator Cum District Collector on 9 December, 2024

Order 
The limited relief claimed by the petitioner in this Writ Petition is for a direction to the 1st respondent to pass an award on the petitioner's claim petition filed under Section 3 G (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, dated 30.07.2024, by following the procedures contemplated under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

2. Heard the learned counsels on the either side and perused the records.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
It is an admitted fact that the claim petition is now pending before the 1st respondent and the same has not been taken up for enquiry.
Therefore, the Writ Petition is allowed.
A mandamus is issued to the 1st respondent to dispose of the claim petition dated 30.07.2024, within a period of 4 months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
